Harness sensors read the GitHub Actions run history of the population their declaration in .devai/config/sensor-inputs.json names (ADR-SCR-0005 IA-004, ADR-SCR-0010); the broker admits exactly this shape without a host adapter under sense run and check: <file> is one workflow file name of letters, digits, dot, underscore, or hyphen ending in .yml or .yaml, without a directory; <event> is one of push, pull_request, merge_group, workflow_dispatch, or schedule, nothing else; <fields> is one to sixteen comma-separated alphabetic names; the limit is the literal 1000, so a thirty-day window at the current volume of about 450 runs is never cut, and a list that returns 1000 runs reads unknown as truncated (#364). This shape carries no --branch option and is emitted when the declared headBranch is * (any head branch); gh-run-list-branch adds the single --branch <ref> option for a literal head branch, and the -created variants add the --created filter. Each option appears once and in this order; a second --branch, a value outside its grammar, and every other gh argv except auth, auth status, --version, and --help are refused.

The harness_green_main sensor narrows gh-run-list by creation date (ADR-SCR-0005 IA-004, ADR-SCR-0010); the broker admits exactly this shape without a host adapter under sense run and check, with the gh-run-list value grammar and <date> an ISO date or datetime after the literal >= prefix.

Harness sensors whose declared headBranch is a literal branch reference pass it as the single --branch <ref> option (ADR-SCR-0005 IA-004, ADR-SCR-0010); the broker admits exactly this shape without a host adapter under sense run and check, with the gh-run-list value grammar and <ref> letters, digits, dot, underscore, slash, or hyphen without a leading hyphen or '..'. A second --branch is refused.

The harness_green_main sensor with a literal head branch narrows gh-run-list-branch by creation date (ADR-SCR-0005 IA-004, ADR-SCR-0010); the broker admits exactly this shape without a host adapter under sense run and check, with the gh-run-list-branch value grammar and <date> an ISO date or datetime after the literal >= prefix.

The harness_green_main sensor under outcomeUnit pull-request-final-head reads every pull request's base, state, creation and closing times and final head to admit only pull requests against the declared base and to match each with the gate runs created while it was open, by head branch and sha (ADR-SCR-0014, #365, ADR-SCR-0005 IA-004); a list that returns 1000 pull requests reads unknown as truncated; the broker admits exactly this argv without a host adapter under sense run and check, every token literal and in this order. Any other gh pr argv is refused.

The site_drift sensor lists the Pages publication deployments that scripts/process/github-pages-journal.mjs records through the GitHub deployments API (ADR-AUT-0002); the broker admits exactly this shape without a host adapter: <owner>/<repo> is the journal repository the sensor declares, the endpoint and query are the fixed strings written here, the method is the implicit GET, and every option is refused, including --method, -X, -f, -F, --field, --raw-field, --input, --paginate, and --hostname. A gh api argv whose repository differs from the declared journal repository, or whose endpoint is neither this shape nor gh-api-pages-deployment-statuses, is refused although the method is GET.

The site_drift sensor lists the statuses of one Pages publication deployment, the journal's intent and verification record (ADR-AUT-0002); the broker admits exactly this shape without a host adapter: <owner>/<repo> is the journal repository the sensor declares, <id> is a decimal integer deployment id taken from gh-api-pages-deployments, the endpoint and query are the fixed strings written here, the method is the implicit GET, and every option is refused, including --method, -X, -f, -F, --field, --raw-field, --input, --paginate, and --hostname. A non-integer <id> is refused.

The build sensor compiles the workspace (ADR-AUT-0002); the compiler writes under the package directories, so the process is a write and never read-only, and recording its reading is an inspector harness-write under the self-dogfood matrix. Under sense run the broker admits exactly this shape without a host adapter. The sensor takes its argv and cwd from the sources argv_precedence lists in that order: a test-tasks.json build node wins, and a build entry in .devai/config/sensor-inputs.json is admitted only when the descriptor has no build node; a declaration whose argv differs from the descriptor node is a declaration defect that the declared-inputs contract test rejects naming both argv and that the sensor reads as error with conflict_code. A declared argv outside this shape is refused before a process starts.

argv_precedence.rule: The argv and cwd of the node whose nodeId is build; when the node exists it is the build sensor's command and no declaration may replace it.
The build input's argv and optional cwd; admitted only when test-tasks.json has no build node, which is the adopter case without a descriptor.

Test sensors run vitest under a governed configuration (ADR-SCR-0005); under sense run the broker admits exactly this shape without a host adapter: <governed-config> is one of tests/config/local.config.ts, tests/config/rc.performance.config.ts, tests/config/rc.e2e.config.ts (the governed e2e configuration the e2e_test declaration names, ADR-SCR-0007), tests/config/local.coverage.config.ts (the database-free coverage producer test_coverage_depth runs for the local population, ADR-SCR-0007), or the suite configurations the test sensor emits (tests/config/t1.unit.config.ts, t3.integration.config.ts, t4.regression.config.ts, t5.e2e.config.ts), and the optional <test-path> is one repository-relative path under tests/ without an empty, '.', or '..' segment (the perf_test declaration passes tests/regression). A bare package script is refused, such as pnpm run test:perf or pnpm lint; the one exception is exactly pnpm test:perf, admitted by template pnpm-test-perf (ADR-AUT-0006).
